items.briefing:
Ransomware attackers are now using AI tools to move faster than ever, giving organisations less time to detect and respond to breaches — a growing concern for all Australian businesses. Separately, a newly discovered flaw called "Certighost" affects Microsoft Active Directory certificate services, which many Australian organisations use for managing user access and identity. If your organisation uses Active Directory, check with your IT team to ensure patches are being monitored and applied promptly.

Locally, Australian firms are rushing to appoint Chief AI Officers as AI adoption accelerates, highlighting the importance of ensuring AI tools are introduced with proper security oversight rather than convenience alone.

**Practical tip:** Ask your IT team whether your Microsoft Active Directory environment has been reviewed for the Certighost vulnerability this week.

featured.title: Ransomware attacks speed up as hackers use AI tools
featured.quote: AI-accelerated ransomware poses escalating threat to Australian manufacturers and critical infrastructure.
